intro: Deadmire's Tooth is a trophy taken from the ancient crocolisk known as Deadmire, who stalks the murky waters of Dustwallow Marsh. Bringing it to the hunter Melor Stonehoof atop Thunder Bluff proves that the aging predator has been granted a merciful and honorable death.

p: In the traditions of the tauren hunters on Hunter Rise, tracking wild beasts is not merely a test of martial prowess or mindless bloodsport. It is a spiritual covenant of balance, reverence, and occasionally, mercy. Deadmire was once one of the most magnificent crocolisks in Dustwallow Marsh, but his great age turned his final years into excruciating torment. Despite possessing the unyielding spirit and terrifying ferocity of his prime, his massive bones and failing body became a prison of endless pain. Claiming Deadmire's Tooth serves as physical proof to Melor Stonehoof that the beast's prolonged suffering has finally been brought to an end through an honorable hunt.
